untouched_test.reason: The original event test pair event-0008-00 was inspected during integration and exposed a static pot-vocabulary failure. That split is therefore development evidence and is not reused for an unbiased composite claim.

development_history: The initial end-to-end test pair was correctly rejected because the static table-state head read a post-call pot as 1.5 BB instead of 2.5 BB.
After retraining the table-state head on paired event frames, the first full validation run completed only 5/8 transitions because integer-only stack OCR failed on decimal and zero stacks.
The first numeric-token stack model reached 63/64 exact validation stacks; its remaining 86.5 BB error exposed unequal renderer glyph widths for digits and the decimal point.

Token-shape geometry now learns integer/decimal structure and decimal position without using whole stack values as labels; the final validation run reconstructed all 64 stacks and all 8 transitions exactly.

conditionally_missing.action_history: missing unless a complete prior history is explicitly evidenced
conditionally_missing.effective_stack_bb: derived only heads-up; unresolved as a scalar in multiway states

limitations: All results are synthetic, closed-vocabulary and uncalibrated; this model card cannot open APC Gate P.
Player identity recognition and complete-hand boundary/history reconstruction are not implemented.
Action recognition requires adjacent frames and the synthetic fixed event banner.
Stack recognition remains tied to renderer-v2 font and geometry despite supporting integer, decimal and zero tokens.
Reference p95 latency is approximately 1.1 seconds because frame features are recomputed; this misses APC's interactive latency target.
A fresh independent composite audit is required after the architecture is frozen.
